'''Fiber Seeds''' are a type of [[Crafting#Seeds|crafted]] seed. They do not require daily watering and can even grow in [[Winter]], but they must still be planted on tilled soil. They can also be eaten by [[Animals#Crows|Crows]] if not protected by a [[Scarecrow]].

The recipe is obtained from [[Linus]] in the mail the day after completing the Special Order [[Quests#Community Cleanup|"Community Cleanup"]].

Each fully-grown plant drops between 4 and 7 [[Fiber]] when harvested with a [[Scythe]].  There is also a 10% chance to drop 1 [[Mixed Seeds]].<ref name="mixedseeds" />

{{#lsth:Fiber|Stages}}
==Tips==
*Fiber Seeds can be planted during the last week of [[Fall]] to prevent [[fertilizer]]s from disappearing on the first day of [[Winter]].
*Although they are not considered "[[Crops]]", [[Junimos]] will still harvest them if in range of a [[Junimo Hut]].
